desc:
A close-quarters battle game, where every fight is fast, brutal, and unpredictable.

Every run is different, forcing you to adapt on the fly. The environment is unforgiving to those who are reckless.

Features:
- Roguelite Elements
- Different modes
- Factions
- Randomly Generated Map
- Aggressive enemy AI
- A vast sandbox (weapons, grenades, medkits)
- Boss fights
- Supports Xbox and Mobile users
- Shooting Range:
  *Includes PVP in Shooting Range

Plus User Benefits:
- +10% XP and Points Boost
- +1 Extra Marketplace Slot

Warning: Exploiters will be banned without any appeal. EMR and Inappropriate clothing will also get an immediate ban.

EPILEPSY WARNING: This game contains flashing lights, muzzle flashes, and intense visual effects that may trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.
